short: Stretchable and self-healing polyurethane coating with syner
title: Stretchable and self-healing polyurethane coating with synergistic anticorrosion effect for the corrosion protection of stainless steels

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Organic barrier coatings on steel lose protection during long saline immersion and once scratched. Combining a 2D MXene barrier with a CeO2 inhibitor in a Diels-Alder crosslinked PU should give synergistic corrosion protection plus sunlight self-healing.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/modification), n5 (DES/variable_sweep), n6 (PRC/synthesis), n7 (PRC/deposition), n19 (PRC/stimulus)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Filler furan groups react with mPU maleimide ends by Diels-Alder, crosslinking fillers into the PU network. F-d@MX fillers are thin lamellar sheets.
states.detail: Absorbed: n8 (STR/chemistry/bonding), n10 (STR/microstructure/shape), n10b (STR/microstructure/shape), n22 (STR/microstructure/damage). Premises: An IR band near 732 cm-1 is assigned to the furan ring

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Lamellar MXene lengthens the diffusion path of water, O2 and Cl- through the coating ('labyrinth' barrier effect). Ce ions precipitate insoluble Ce(OH)3/CeO2 on the steel, adding active corrosion inhibition.
states.detail: Absorbed: n13 (MEC/pathway), n14 (MEC/pathway), n15 (PRP/value), n15b (PRP/value), n20 (MEC/pathway). Premises: Impermeable platelets aligned in a matrix raise diffusion tortuosity and slow permeant transport; Ce3+/Ce4+ react with cathodically generated OH- to precipitate insoluble Ce(OH)3/CeO2 films; The authors' earlier DA-crosslinked PU healed when heated through retro-DA/DA bond exchange

states.title: Performance state
states.head: PCM2 coating keeps |Z|0.01Hz near 1e9 ohm cm2 for ~4 weeks and above 1e8 after 60 days in 3.5 wt% NaCl. Healed PCM2 coating gives the same 1-day impedance as pristine: anticorrosion recovered after healing

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: A DA-crosslinked PU with mixed F-d@MX/F-d@Ce fillers gives synergistic barrier + inhibitor protection and restores it by sunlight self-healing

nodes.title: MICRO, F2
nodes.head: A single sphere ~200-250 nm across with a granular, rough surface. Stacked, near-vertical thin sheets tens of nm thick, with rounded particles lodged between them
nodes.solves: F-d@Ce fillers are rough-surfaced spheres ~200-250 nm across
nodes.note: diameter measured against the 50 nm bar sheet faces look fairly smooth; the roughening claimed in linked text is not evident at this magnification
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n10b, n10 (o3, o4).

nodes.title: MICRO, F7
nodes.head: An open groove with an undercut edge becomes a continuous surface with only a faint band after healing
nodes.solves: The scratch closes after 1 min of sunlight; only a faint trace remains
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown, and n22 keeps shown support from o15.

nodes.solves: Filler furan groups react with mPU maleimide ends by Diels-Alder, crosslinking fillers into the PU network
nodes.op: compare across conditions, cross check consistency
nodes.note: linked text: 'absorption at 732 cm-1 corresponding to furan ring'; F-d@MX trace has only noise-level wiggles there

nodes.head: A small N 1s peak near 400 eV appears in the F-d@Ce survey but not in bare CeO2
nodes.note: MXene and F-d@MX both show weak features near 400 eV, so the MXene comparison is less clear; PCM survey shows no Ce 3d or Ti peaks and two sharp unlabelled peaks near 100 and 160 eV
nodes.detail: o2: A small N 1s peak near 400 eV appears in the F-d@Ce survey but not in bare CeO2

nodes.title: ECHEM:EIS, F4, F5
nodes.head: Ecorr moves from ~-0.94 V (mPU) to ~-0.75 V (PCM2, most positive); mPU branches carry the highest current. mPU impedance lies near zero on the GOhm axis at both times; filled coatings plateau at ~0.4-2 GOhm cm2
nodes.solves: Filled coatings resist 3.5 wt% NaCl corrosion far better than unfilled mPU
nodes.note: current minima: PCM2 and PCM2(Ce) lowest (~10^-9.4 A/cm2), mPU ~10^-7.9 3-D offset Bode plots: absolute levels are approximate
nodes.detail: o9: Ecorr moves from ~-0.94 V (mPU) to ~-0.75 V (PCM2, most positive); mPU branches carry the highest current; o10: mPU impedance lies near zero on the GOhm axis at both times; filled coatings plateau at ~0.4-2 GOhm cm2
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n15 (o9, o10).

nodes.title: ECHEM:EIS, F5
nodes.head: At the latest time the 2wt% coating keeps the highest low-frequency |Z| (~0.25-0.3 GOhm cm2); 0.5wt%, 2wt%-MX and 5wt% fall lowest
nodes.solves: Mixed-filler PCM1/PCM2 keep the highest impedance at 60 days, above single-filler PCM2-Ce and PCM2-MX
nodes.note: bottom Nyquist: 0.5wt%, 2wt%-MX and 5wt% give small distorted arcs under ~1 MOhm cm2; 1wt% and 2wt% rise steeply off-scale; 2wt%-Ce gives a long arc to ~2 MOhm cm2
